description: This file defines an Android Fragment class named LogFragment which manages a custom LogView for displaying log data, handling view creation, layout, and text updates.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that contains a LogView component for displaying log information, manages view setup and scroll behavior.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView for displaying logs.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes views when fragment's view is created, and sets up a TextWatcher to scroll to the bottom after text changes.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
